name: Queen's Gambit
description: A beginner course for challenging Black's d-pawn with c4 and understanding common replies.

branches.title: Main Line: Offer c4
branches.description: Learn the default Queen's Gambit start.

moves.title: Start with d4
moves.explanation: Controls central squares and opens the c1 bishop.

moves.title: Black mirrors
moves.explanation: Black places a pawn on the same central front.

moves.title: Challenge d5
moves.explanation: c4 attacks Black's d5 pawn and asks Black how they will defend the center.

hints: The target response in this branch is c4.
Use the highlighted move and keep the plan simple.

branches.title: Queen's Gambit Accepted
branches.description: If Black takes the pawn, develop and win it back later.

moves.title: Black accepts
moves.explanation: Black grabs the c-pawn. The beginner response is not panic.

moves.title: Recommended: develop
moves.explanation: Nf3 develops and prepares e3 to recover the pawn. Development matters more than immediate material.

hints: The target response in this branch is Nf3.
Use the highlighted move and keep the plan simple.

branches.title: Queen's Gambit Declined
branches.description: If Black supports d5 with e6, develop naturally.

moves.title: Black declines
moves.explanation: Black supports d5 and opens the f8 bishop.

moves.title: Recommended: develop pressure
moves.explanation: Nc3 develops and adds pressure to d5. Continue with Nf3 and Bg5 or e3.

moves.explanation: c4 builds a queen-pawn center and keeps the Queen's Gambit style structure.
